chars.IMAD: IMAD: a tall slim young man wearing a mustard-yellow corduroy overshirt over a white t-shirt, black jeans and white sneakers.
chars.NOAH: NOAH: a short stocky young man wearing a dark green bomber jacket with a red stripe on the sleeves, grey trousers and a silver wristwatch.
chars.WAITRESS: WAITRESS: a young woman waitress wearing a black waistcoat over a white shirt with a small red bow tie and a black apron, her hair hidden under a black cap.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Inside a dim lounge bar in Casablanca at night. In the foreground the WAITRESS leans close to IMAD and whispers urgently into his ear, her face worried; IMAD freezes, eyes wide in shock. Behind them, at a table in the background, NOAH watches them with a suspicious narrow look, holding a glass.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Night street in Casablanca with palm trees and white art-deco buildings, warm neon glow. IMAD and NOAH walk side by side toward the entrance of a chic lounge bar, NOAH with his arm on IMAD's shoulder, both smiling, ready to party.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Inside a chic dim lounge bar in Casablanca with warm lamps. IMAD and NOAH sit facing each other at a small round table with two glasses, laughing together like brothers.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Inside the lounge bar. IMAD stands up from the small table and walks away toward a dim corridor at the back; NOAH stays seated at the table, looking at IMAD's glass with a sly half smile.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: A dim narrow corridor at the back of the bar near the restrooms. The WAITRESS stops IMAD, holding his arm, looking nervous and glancing over her shoulder; IMAD looks at her confused.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Flashback at the bar counter. NOAH secretly slips a folded stack of banknotes and a tiny white paper packet of powder into the WAITRESS's hand under the counter, leaning in with a cold serious face; the WAITRESS looks uneasy.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: In the dim corridor, the WAITRESS shows IMAD the stack of banknotes in her open hand, shaking her head with a frightened face as if saying she refuses; IMAD stares at the money in disbelief.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: View from the dark corridor: IMAD in the foreground peeks around the corner, stunned and sweating, hand on his head; far away in the bright bar NOAH sits alone at the table, calmly waiting next to two fresh glasses.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Inside the lounge bar. IMAD walks slowly back to the table with a tense forced smile; NOAH smiles widely and pushes a full fresh glass across the table toward IMAD. Tense atmosphere.
